quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: 2025 revenue RMB 24.84 billion, up 187.29% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 9.53 billion, up 235.89%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 4.05 billion, Q2 RMB 6.38 billion, Q3 RMB 6.07 billion, Q4 RMB 8.34 billion (Q4 net profit attributable RMB 3.20 billion). Optical interconnect products were RMB 24.77 billion (99.72% of revenue) at a 47.81% gross margin (2024: 44.85%); overseas revenue RMB 23.89 billion, 96.16% of revenue, up 251.03%, while domestic revenue fell 48.19%.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 24.84 billion (+187.29%); net profit RMB 9.53 billion (+235.89%); gross margin 47.81%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: optical interconnect product capacity was 1,747 ten-thousand units in 2025 (2024: 1095 ten-thousand), output 1,634 ten-thousand (+66.06%) and sales 1,603 ten-thousand (+82.78%), with 175 ten-thousand units in year-end inventory. Company: sales rose mainly on higher customer demand, output rose as the company added investment and lifted capacity, and product-mix change plus efficiency gains raised gross margin. Phase 2 of the Thailand factory began formal operation in early 2025 and its capacity is still being released; the Thailand subsidiary (optical module production) had 2025 revenue of RMB 21.91 billion and net profit of RMB 1.41 billion.

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D spend RMB 702,143,848.24 (up 74.16%), 2.83% of revenue, none capitalised; R&D staff 805 (2024: 605). Project status: LPO modules, direct-drive silicon-photonics QSFP-DD/OSFP modules, 800G AEC cable modules (power under 11W) and 1.6T modules passed acceptance; LRO modules, coherent modules, liquid-cooled modules and the in-house silicon-photonics PIC project entered small-batch production; the OCS platform (electrostatic MEMS), 1.6T AEC, 1.6T silicon-photonics LPO, 1.6T 4xDR4, 6.4T IPO and 12.8T XPO module projects finished early sample testing and evaluation.

2025 annual report: in March 2026 the company released (company: first in the industry) several new products for AI data-center interconnect, including a 1.6T DR4 module based on single-wave 400G IMDD, a 6.4T NPO module based on silicon photonics and a 12.8T XPO pluggable module (company: the industry's first 12.8T XPO); it has also launched an optical circuit switch (OCS) carrying its self-developed MEMS chip.

2025 annual report: company strategy is vertical integration across optical chip R&D, optical device packaging and optical module manufacturing; its in-house silicon-photonics PIC project (in small-batch production) is meant to move it from purchasing and assembling to core in-house development and to significantly reduce reliance on upstream chip suppliers.

2025 annual report, 2026 business plan: on top of continuing to raise 800G and 1.6T optical module capacity, the company will push new products toward higher speed, higher density and lower power, and increase R&D and industrialisation of XPO, NPO, CPO and OCS products; it also plans an automated, intelligent flexible manufacturing system to cut inventory and production cycles.
